        function enableInteractions() {
            const links = document.querySelectorAll('a');
            links.forEach(link => {
                if (link.href) {
                    link.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
                }
            });

            const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('button, input[type="submit"]');

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            const clickableElements = document.querySelectorAll('a, button, input[type="submit"]');
            
            clickableElements.forEach(element => {
                element.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                    if (element.tagName === 'A' && (!element.hasAttribute('href') || element.getAttribute('href') === '#')) {
                        return;
                    }

                    if (this.classList.contains('processing')) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        return false;
                    }
                    
                    clickableElements.forEach(el => {
                        el.classList.add('processing');
                    });

                    setTimeout(() => {
                        clickableElements.forEach(el => {
                            el.classList.remove('processing');
                        });
                    }, 2000);
                });
            });
        });

    function getLive(tempo) {
        setTimeout(function() {
            $.ajax({
                type: "GET",
                url: window.defaultUrl + 'home/getLives',
                timeout: 3000,
                datatype: 'JSON',
                cache: false,
                error: function() {

                },
                success: function(retorno) {
                    if (retorno.live.id !== undefined || retorno.live.id !== '') {
                        $('#iFrameFixVideo').attr('src', 'https://www.youtube.com/embed/' + retorno.live.id );
                        $('#container-video').show();
                    } else {
                        $('#container-video').hide();
                    }
                    getLive(600000);
                }
            });
        }, tempo)
    }

    $(window).on("load", function(){
        getLive(5000);
    });

        function disableInteractions() {
            const links = document.querySelectorAll('a');
            links.forEach(link => {
                if (link.href && !link.href.includes('#')) {
                    link.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
                }
            });

            const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('button, input[type="submit"]');
            buttons.forEach(button => {
                button.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
            });
        }

        function enableInteractions() {
            const links = document.querySelectorAll('a');
            links.forEach(link => {
                if (link.href) {
                    link.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
                }
            });

            const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('button, input[type="submit"]');
            buttons.forEach(button => {
                button.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
            });
        }

        function preventFormSubmit(event) {
            event.preventDefault();
        }

                    disableInteractions();
        
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            const clickableElements = document.querySelectorAll('a, button, input[type="submit"]');
            
            clickableElements.forEach(element => {
                element.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                    if (element.tagName === 'A' && (!element.hasAttribute('href') || element.getAttribute('href') === '#')) {
                        return;
                    }

                    if (this.classList.contains('processing')) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        return false;
                    }
                    
                    clickableElements.forEach(el => {
                        el.classList.add('processing');
                    });

                    setTimeout(() => {
                        clickableElements.forEach(el => {
                            el.classList.remove('processing');
                        });
                    }, 2000);
                });
            });
        });

            $.ajax({
                type: "GET",
                url: window.defaultUrl + 'home/getLives',
                timeout: 3000,
                datatype: 'JSON',
                cache: false,

    function getLive(tempo) {
        setTimeout(function() {
            $.ajax({
                type: "GET",
                url: window.defaultUrl + 'home/getLives',
                timeout: 3000,
                datatype: 'JSON',
                cache: false,
                error: function() {

                },
                success: function(retorno) {
                    if (retorno.live.id !== undefined || retorno.live.id !== '') {
                        $('#iFrameFixVideo').attr('src', 'https://www.youtube.com/embed/' + retorno.live.id );
                        $('#container-video').show();
                    } else {
                        $('#container-video').hide();
                    }
                    getLive(600000);
                }
            });
        }, tempo)
    }

    $(window).on("load", function(){
        getLive(5000);

    function getLive(tempo) {
        setTimeout(function() {
            $.ajax({
                type: "GET",
                url: window.defaultUrl + 'home/getLives',
                timeout: 3000,
                datatype: 'JSON',
                cache: false,
                error: function() {

                },
                success: function(retorno) {
                    if (retorno.live.id !== undefined || retorno.live.id !== '') {
                        $('#iFrameFixVideo').attr('src', 'https://www.youtube.com/embed/' + retorno.live.id );
                        $('#container-video').show();
                    } else {
                        $('#container-video').hide();
                    }
                    getLive(600000);
                }
            });
        }, tempo)
    }

    $(window).on("load", function(){
        getLive(5000);
